- [ ] R14 library-component receipt reconciles all five library stories plus GOV026, exact published documentation/artifacts, completed final-head reviews, checks and readback. manual_metrics_rows.definition: Distinct external people voluntarily reporting an attempt of the declared demo/version; deduplicate repeat commands per person. Exclude maintainer automation and CI. If permitted evidence cannot establish uniqueness, record UNKNOWN; do not collect identity to meet a target.
manual_metrics_rows.evidence: No selected or started operational pilot; empty scoped manual event ledger.

manual_metrics_rows.definition: Distinct actionable, rights-safe reports with version/command, synthetic reproduction and expected/observed behavior; deduplicate underlying problems. A confirmed product defect is not required. Stars, likes and acknowledgments do not count.
manual_metrics_rows.evidence: No selected or started pilot and no collected cohort reports.

manual_metrics_rows.definition: Distinct external contributors whose first scoped code/documentation issue change is accepted through ordinary review and verified default-branch delivery. Drafts, starter creation, maintainer automation and review revisions do not count.
manual_metrics_rows.evidence: No observed pilot cohort; public starter opportunities remain unimplemented.

manual_metrics_rows.definition: An eligible first contributor later delivers a separate accepted change for a distinct issue. Split commits or rework within the same contribution do not qualify. If linkage cannot be established from permitted public/consented evidence, record UNKNOWN.
manual_metrics_rows.evidence: No eligible first contributors in the unstarted scoped pilot; no denominator.

manual_metrics_rows.definition: UTC first substantive maintainer triage minus report timestamp; classify response human, automated or unknown. Exclude automatic acknowledgments; publish only aggregate sample scope.
manual_metrics_rows.evidence: No eligible scoped reports; no response is never zero seconds and no response SLA is selected.

manual_metrics_rows.definition: Actual separately authorized external submissions/invitations; prepared drafts and repository delivery are distinct.
